title: Life After the DClinPsy: Job Uncertainty, Anxiety & Real Choices

sentences.en: Psychologists, what if you could earn money beyond trading your time for money?
sentences.zh: 心理学家们，如果你们能赚到除了出卖时间换取金钱之外的收入，那会怎样？

sentences.en: I'm Dr. Marianne Trent, clinical psychologist, and I've been developing passive and recurring income streams since 2019.
sentences.zh: 我是临床心理学家 Marianne Trent 博士，自 2019 年以来，我一直在开发被动和循环收入流。

sentences.en: I have some exciting news.
sentences.zh: 我有个好消息要告诉大家。

sentences.en: Sophie Foote's One-to-Many program is now open for enrollment.
sentences.zh: Sophie Foote 的“一对多”项目现在开放报名了。

sentences.en: It's designed to help you turn your expertise into scalable offers like courses, memberships, and digital products.
sentences.zh: 它旨在帮助你将专业知识转化为可扩展的产品，如课程、会员资格和数字产品。

sentences.en: I completed the program myself in 2022 and have since supported two cohorts of psychologists through their journeys too.
sentences.zh: 我自己在 2022 年完成了这个项目，此后也支持了两批心理学家走过他们的历程。

sentences.en: And if you join through my affiliate link, you'll receive Sophie's bonuses plus my own exclusive support package at no extra coSt.
sentences.zh: 如果你通过我的联盟链接加入，你将获得 Sophie 的奖励，以及我提供的独家支持套餐，无需额外费用。

sentences.en: That includes six months of WhatsApp support, four group masterminds, masterclasses, personalized guidance, a Fortnum and Mason treat, and a time-limited one-to-one coaching bonus.
sentences.zh: 这包括六个月的 WhatsApp 支持、四次小组智囊团会议、大师课、个性化指导、一份 Fortnum and Mason 的礼物，以及限时的一对一辅导奖励。

sentences.en: Enrollment closes on Monday the 16th of November at 10pm.
sentences.zh: 报名将于 11 月 16 日星期一晚上 10 点截止。

sentences.en: Find out more via my bonus page linked in the description.
sentences.zh: 通过描述中链接的我的奖励页面了解更多信息。

sentences.en: And remember, you must purchase through my link to receive my bonuses.
sentences.zh: 请记住，你必须通过我的链接购买才能获得我的奖励。

sentences.en: I'm here if you have any questions.
sentences.zh: 如果你有任何问题，我随时都在。

sentences.en: For three years, trainee psychologists believe they're climbing a ladder that leads straight to a qualified poSt.
sentences.zh: 三年来，实习心理学家们一直以为他们正在攀登一架直通合格职位的梯子。

sentences.en: But in reality, that ladder can stop abruptly.
sentences.zh: 但实际上，那架梯子可能会突然中断。

sentences.en: You might step off into a job market where roles are scarce, jobs are part-time, and some psychologists even find themselves signing on at the job center.
sentences.zh: 你可能会步入一个职位稀缺、工作多为兼职的就业市场，有些心理学家甚至发现自己不得不去就业中心登记失业。

sentences.en: Not because they aren't skilled, but because the system really isn't designed for this.
sentences.zh: 不是因为他们不够专业，而是因为这个系统确实不是为此设计的。

sentences.en: Today, we are pulling back the curtain on what it's really like at this stage,
sentences.zh: 今天，我们将揭开这个阶段真实情况的帷幕，

sentences.en: from someone who's living it right now as an end-stage trainee, and someone who's been through it already as a qualified clinician.
sentences.zh: 通过一位正处于实习末期、亲身经历着这一切的人，以及一位已经作为合格临床医生走过这段路的人的视角。

sentences.en: If you want the truth about what it's like to jump from trainee to qualified, this is the episode for you.
sentences.zh: 如果你想了解从实习生到合格心理学家这一转变的真相，这一集就是为你准备的。

sentences.en: And if you find it helpful, please do like and subscribe for more.
sentences.zh: 如果你觉得有帮助，请点赞并订阅以获取更多内容。

sentences.en: Hi, welcome along to the podcaSt.
sentences.zh: 嗨，欢迎来到本播客。

sentences.en: I'm Dr. Marianne, a qualified clinical psychologiSt.
sentences.zh: 我是 Marianne 博士，一名合格的临床心理学家。

sentences.en: And today, I'm welcoming back Tanya Well-Milligate to the podcaSt.
sentences.zh: 今天，我再次欢迎 Tanya Well-Milligate 来到播客。

sentences.en: Hello again, Tanya.
sentences.zh: 你好，Tanya。

sentences.en: Hi, Marianne.
sentences.zh: 嗨，Marianne。

sentences.en: Thank you for inviting me back for another one.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你再次邀请我参加节目。

sentences.en: So, yeah, looking forward to speaking today.
sentences.zh: 是的，很期待今天的交流。

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 当然。

sentences.en: And we really wanted to think about what it's like when you are nearing the end of training,
sentences.zh: 我们真的很想探讨一下当你接近培训尾声时是什么感觉，

sentences.en: or maybe even when you've qualified, and then you are having to apply for jobs, which may or may not be there.
sentences.zh: 或者甚至当你已经获得资格，然后不得不去申请那些可能存在、也可能不存在的工作时。

sentences.en: Certainly, in my own experience in 2011, they were not there.
sentences.zh: 当然，以我 2011 年的亲身经历来说，当时确实没有工作岗位。

sentences.en: Of a cohort of 16 when we qualified, I think three of us had jobs to go to when the course ended, and I was not one of those people.
sentences.zh: 在我们获得资格的那 16 人中，我想只有三个人在课程结束时有工作可去，而我并不在其中。

sentences.en: How is the landscape looking currently, Tanya?
sentences.zh: Tanya，目前的就业前景如何？

sentences.en: Yeah, so I think, so from my, and I guess this is also kind of like my own experiences as a trainee,
sentences.zh: 是的，我想，从我个人的角度，我想这也是我作为实习生的一些经历，

sentences.en: and, you know, coming towards the end of it, and in third year, it's quite bittersweet, because, like you said, coming towards an end, the end is in sight.
sentences.zh: 你知道，快要结束的时候，在第三年，这感觉相当苦乐参半，因为正如你所说，终点就在眼前。

sentences.en: We're kind of looking forward to kind of finishing, qualifying, not having the pressure of the course and the thesis on us anymore.
sentences.zh: 我们都在期待着完成学业、获得资格，不再承受课程和论文的压力。

sentences.en: But then also, that means that then we go into the real world and kind of go into qualified life and stepping into a job.
sentences.zh: 但这也意味着我们要进入现实世界，开始合格后的生活，并步入工作岗位。

sentences.en: And I think, you know, if three years ago, someone said that you might not, you know, you might struggle to find a job as a qualified psychologist,
sentences.zh: 我想，如果三年前有人说你可能，你知道，你可能很难找到一份合格心理学家的工作，

sentences.en: maybe that would make me think a little bit before I'd have maybe a few more conversations and think about employment prospects post-qualifying.
sentences.zh: 也许我会多思考一下，可能会进行更多的交谈，并考虑获得资格后的就业前景。

sentences.en: So I think that's something that myself and my fellow trainees and trainees in third year and other universities are having conversations about is the availability of those jobs.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为，我和我的实习生同伴们，以及其他大学三年级的实习生们，都在讨论这些职位的可用性。

sentences.en: And because our friends in cohorts above us have struggled a little bit to find employment and secure a job.
sentences.zh: 因为我们上一届的朋友在寻找就业和获得工作方面遇到了一些困难。

sentences.en: Sometimes it's possible to do that in your last placement to secure a job.
sentences.zh: 有时在最后一次实习中确实有可能获得一份工作。

sentences.en: And as you mentioned, you had three trainees in your cohort that were able to do that.
sentences.zh: 正如你提到的，你们那一届有三名实习生做到了这一点。

sentences.en: But for others, we're talking a couple of months of interviewing and kind of going through the process.
sentences.zh: 但对于其他人，我们谈论的是几个月的面试和走流程。

sentences.en: And that can be really tricky and a little bit anxiety provoking, you know,
sentences.zh: 这可能真的非常棘手，而且有点让人焦虑，你知道，

sentences.en: if we have other commitments like children or mortgages to pay other responsibilities that mean that being out of work for an extended period of time is very tricky and yeah,
sentences.zh: 如果我们还有其他负担，比如孩子或房贷，或者其他意味着长期失业会非常困难的责任，是的，

sentences.en: costly.
sentences.zh: 代价高昂。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And something I did not envisage in my very newly qualified doctor days was joining the queue at the job centre and going and signing on, you know,
sentences.zh: 在我刚获得博士资格的日子里，我从未设想过自己会去就业中心排队登记，你知道，

sentences.en: having to do certain job seeking responsibilities every week and going physically to the job centre to have meetings and be able to, you know, to claim that money.
sentences.zh: 每周必须履行某些求职责任，还要亲自去就业中心开会，才能领取那笔钱。

sentences.en: And for me,
sentences.zh: 对我来说，

sentences.en: it was important that I did do that because I didn't know how long I was going to be unemployed and I wanted my kind of national insurance stamps to kind of show the system that I was still existing.
sentences.zh: 这样做很重要，因为我不知道自己会失业多久，我希望我的国民保险记录能向系统证明我仍然存在。

sentences.en: And yeah, it was interesting conversations to have with people in the job centre when they're like, oh, you know, you could apply for this, you could apply for that.
sentences.zh: 而且，和就业中心的人进行那些对话很有趣，他们会说，哦，你知道，你可以申请这个，你可以申请那个。

sentences.en: And it's like, I know the jobs are coming.
sentences.zh: 而我的想法是，我知道工作机会会有的。

sentences.en: Just give me a little bit more time.
sentences.zh: 再给我一点时间。

sentences.en: Yes, I know I could potentially go and, you know, apply to Aldi, but I don't think I'm quite at that stage yet.
sentences.zh: 是的，我知道我可能可以去申请 Aldi 的工作，但我认为我还没到那个阶段。

sentences.en: Like, I really would like to just look for qualified psych jobs and please just allow me a little bit more time.
sentences.zh: 我真的只想寻找合格的心理学工作，请再给我一点时间。

sentences.en: And yeah, like, so please de-shame that process.
sentences.zh: 所以，请消除对这个过程的羞耻感。

sentences.en: If you're out of work, you know, a fixed term contract has ended, you know, there are benefits available, but yes, certainly not what I expected.
sentences.zh: 如果你失业了，你知道，固定期限合同结束了，确实有福利可以领取，但当然，这绝不是我所期望的。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Thank you, Marianne, for sharing that, because I think, yeah, there is a bit of a stigma around it.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你分享这些，Marianne，因为我认为，是的，这周围确实存在一点污名。

sentences.en: It's like, oh, do you have something lined up?
sentences.zh: 就像是，哦，你已经安排好工作了吗？

sentences.en: Have you done your interviews?
sentences.zh: 你面试过了吗？

sentences.en: You know, and maybe if people feel like they might need to pivot around psychology for a short time or to think about alternative options.
sentences.zh: 你知道，如果人们觉得他们可能需要在心理学领域之外进行短暂的调整，或者考虑其他选择。

sentences.en: And yeah, there may be a little bit of stigma around that.
sentences.zh: 是的，这周围可能确实存在一点污名。

sentences.en: And I think, like you said, you know, the training is a fixed term contract and it's been three years of obviously a lot of change,
sentences.zh: 而且我认为，就像你说的，你知道，培训是一份固定期限的合同，过去三年里显然有很多变化，

sentences.en: but in some ways a lot of consistency because we knew the next three years we'd be on a fixed term contract.
sentences.zh: 但在某些方面也有很多稳定性，因为我们知道未来三年我们会有固定期限的合同。

sentences.en: We'd have, it's a salaried job.
sentences.zh: 这是一份有薪水的工作。

sentences.en: We would get paid every month.
sentences.zh: 我们每个月都会拿到工资。

sentences.en: And so there was security in that over the last three years, but, and, you know, arguably before that in assistant psychology posts or RA posts, there is that consistency.
sentences.zh: 所以在过去三年里，这给了我们安全感，而且，可以说在此之前，在助理心理学家职位或研究助理职位上，也有那种稳定性。

sentences.en: And, you know, it's a, to training, it's like a step ladder and you're kind of going up that.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，对于培训来说，这就像一个梯子，你正在往上爬。

sentences.en: And when you get to the top, it's like, well, I imagine it's going to keep going, but, you know, unexpectedly, you might not see that next bit.
sentences.zh: 当你爬到顶端时，你会想，好吧，我想它会继续延伸，但出乎意料的是，你可能看不到下一截。

sentences.en: And I think that does cause a little bit of anxiety.
sentences.zh: 我认为这确实引起了一些焦虑。

sentences.en: And so, yeah, I mean, we were speaking a little bit about how courses are increasing and how it can be difficult, I guess,
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，我的意思是，我们刚才谈到课程数量在增加，以及我认为，

sentences.en: with funding through the NHS to fund more positions for qualified psychologists.
sentences.zh: 通过 NHS 的资金来资助更多合格心理学家的职位是多么困难。

sentences.en: So I guess that's something to think about as well.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为这也是需要考虑的事情。

sentences.en: I mean, we're a cohort of 56 now, so I'm not sure if there'll be 56 jobs in London, but it's, yeah, it's those kinds of conversation that we're having at the moment.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我们现在有 56 人的规模，所以我不确定伦敦是否会有 56 个职位，但，是的，这就是我们目前正在进行的对话。

sentences.en: Yeah, and of course, you're not the only London course.
sentences.zh: 是的，当然，你并不是伦敦唯一的课程。

sentences.en: And what we often forget is that other qualified psychologists might have applied last year and might be looking to apply for those jobs as well.
sentences.zh: 我们经常忘记的是，其他合格的心理学家可能去年就申请过，也可能正在寻找这些工作。

sentences.en: And of course, if they've got a one year post-qualification experience, they might be more likely to get that job.
sentences.zh: 当然，如果他们有一年的资格后经验，他们可能更有可能得到那份工作。

sentences.en: So you're not necessarily just competing with your cohort, like you could be, it's an open market.
sentences.zh: 所以你不一定只是在和你的同届竞争，这就像是一个开放的市场。

sentences.en: And yeah, like we had a little look before we started recording at the clearinghouse data for how course places have changed over the years.
sentences.zh: 是的，在我们开始录音之前，我们稍微看了一下清算所的数据，了解课程名额多年来的变化。

sentences.en: And when I trained, there was 15 of us.
sentences.zh: 我受训时，我们有 15 个人。

sentences.en: And it's interesting that actually, even though the numbers have gone up over time, currently they're at 15 again, the course that I trained with.
sentences.zh: 有趣的是，实际上，尽管人数随着时间推移有所增加，但目前又回到了 15 人，和我受训时的课程一样。

sentences.en: And your course has got much bigger and then has come back down again to kind of the 56.
sentences.zh: 而你的课程规模变得大得多，然后又回落到了 56 人左右。

sentences.en: And it's, yeah, it's the sustainability.
sentences.zh: 这就是可持续性的问题。

sentences.en: So I think they do try and predict and plan.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为他们确实在尝试预测和规划。

sentences.en: But I think a lot of that is, it feels like it's more linked to budgets,
sentences.zh: 但我认为这很大程度上感觉更多是与预算挂钩，

sentences.en: how much money they've got to be able to train psychologists rather than necessarily looking at job forecasting.
sentences.zh: 他们有多少钱来培训心理学家，而不是必然在关注就业预测。

sentences.en: And yeah, it's really hard because I think you kind of think, oh, well, I've taken, you know, lower paid work to be able to get onto the doctorate.
sentences.zh: 是的，这真的很难，因为我想你会觉得，哦，好吧，我已经接受了，你知道，低薪工作来进入博士课程。

sentences.en: And you, maybe it's this naive hope or trust in the system that you'll be looked after ultimately or eventually.
sentences.zh: 也许这是一种天真的希望，或者对系统的信任，认为你最终会得到照顾。

sentences.en: And then when you get qualified, you will have a job.
sentences.zh: 然后当你获得资格时，你就会有一份工作。

sentences.en: But yeah, getting a trainee psychologist role is not a guarantee of employment.
sentences.zh: 但是的，获得实习心理学家的角色并不能保证就业。

sentences.en: You know, it's hopefully that if you jump through all the white hoops, it's a guarantee that you'll come out the other end as a qualified psych.
sentences.zh: 你知道，希望如果你跳过了所有的圈套，就能保证你最终会成为一名合格的心理学家。

sentences.en: The rest is, the rest is not promised.
sentences.zh: 剩下的，剩下的并没有保证。

sentences.en: Yeah, totally.
sentences.zh: 是的，完全同意。

sentences.en: And I think something that we're finding more is, you know, as we've been saying that the courses have been increasing,
sentences.zh: 我认为我们发现更多的是，正如我们所说，课程一直在增加，

sentences.en: but also posts have been become more broader in terms of what they're looking for.
sentences.zh: 但职位的要求也变得更加广泛。

sentences.en: So you might have in one job advertisement, you know, clinical or counselling psychologist or clinical or counselling or practitioner or CBT therapiSt.
sentences.zh: 所以你可能会在同一个招聘广告中看到，你知道，临床或咨询心理学家，或者临床或咨询或从业者或 CBT 治疗师。

sentences.en: So it's like the pool becomes bigger as well.
sentences.zh: 所以这就像是人才池也变大了。

sentences.en: And so not only are you kind of competing against other trainees, but also qualified psychologists, there are other practitioner psychologists who fall under that.
sentences.zh: 因此，你不仅是在与其他实习生竞争，还有合格的心理学家，以及其他属于该范畴的从业心理学家。

sentences.en: And so there's a lot more to it than, yeah, maybe rounds of interviews.
sentences.zh: 所以这不仅仅是几轮面试那么简单。

sentences.en: I don't know.
sentences.zh: 我不知道。

sentences.en: I'm not sure how they do it, do that now.
sentences.zh: 我不确定他们现在是怎么做的。

sentences.en: And also a lot of positions being part time can, you know, cause a lot of strain on the individual if they're having to kind of juggle more than one job.
sentences.zh: 而且很多职位是兼职的，如果他们不得不兼顾不止一份工作，这可能会给个人造成很大的压力。

sentences.en: Or I know a friend of a friend is working two NHS posts part time and doing private work, you know, because they've recently just bought a house.
sentences.zh: 或者我知道一个朋友的朋友正在做两份 NHS 的兼职工作，同时还做私人工作，你知道，因为他们最近刚买了房子。

sentences.en: So it's like having to juggle all of those things maybe wasn't something that we'd anticipated prior to kind of applying and doing the training.
sentences.zh: 所以不得不兼顾所有这些事情，可能并不是我们在申请和进行培训之前所预料到的。

sentences.en: So, yeah, it's kind of opening up this whole other world of post-qualified life.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，这开启了合格后生活的另一个世界。

sentences.en: And I think it's, yeah, causing a bit of anxiety.
sentences.zh: 我认为这确实引起了一些焦虑。

sentences.en: Yeah, and private practice always used to be something that you probably perhaps thought about starting as you were winding down to semi-retire, maybe.
sentences.zh: 是的，私人执业过去常常是你可能在考虑半退休时才会想到的事情，也许吧。

sentences.en: And, you know, that's not the case these days for sure.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，现在肯定不是这样了。

sentences.en: Maybe it was never the case.
sentences.zh: 也许从来都不是这样。

sentences.en: That might have just been my own assumption.
sentences.zh: 那可能只是我自己的假设。

sentences.en: But, yeah, I think for my own imposter syndrome, I didn't start my private practice until 2019 and I'd qualified in 2011.
sentences.zh: 但是，是的，我认为对于我自己的冒名顶替综合症，直到 2019 年我才开始私人执业，而我是在 2011 年获得资格的。

sentences.en: So I definitely felt like I needed some qualified years under my belt.
sentences.zh: 所以我确实觉得我需要一些合格后的工作年限。

sentences.en: Even then, I still had this imposter syndrome about doing that with eight years post-qualification experience.
sentences.zh: 即使那样，在拥有八年资格后经验的情况下，我仍然对这样做感到冒名顶替综合症。

sentences.en: And I'd also become a mother during those times.
sentences.zh: 而且在那段时间里我也成为了一名母亲。

sentences.en: So I felt like I'd kind of learned about very new and different ways of kind of understanding psychology in the real world as well.
sentences.zh: 所以我感觉我也学到了关于在现实世界中理解心理学的非常新颖和不同的方式。

sentences.en: But, yeah, people are, you know, having to think about private practice as a way of primarily, you know, paying the bills.
sentences.zh: 但是，是的，人们，你知道，不得不考虑将私人执业作为一种主要的，你知道，支付账单的方式。

sentences.en: And this is not necessarily a free choice.
sentences.zh: 这不一定是一个自由的选择。

sentences.en: You know, when I started training, I hand on heart would have said I will be working for the NHS until I retire.
sentences.zh: 你知道，当我开始培训时，我真心实意地说过，我会一直在 NHS 工作直到退休。

sentences.en: That is what I thought I would be doing.
sentences.zh: 那就是我以为我会做的事情。

sentences.en: That is not what has happened at all.
sentences.zh: 那根本不是后来发生的事情。

sentences.en: So it's having to make different choices than that which we thought to be able to live our lives.
sentences.zh: 所以为了生活，我们不得不做出与我们当初所想不同的选择。

sentences.en: Yeah, totally.
sentences.zh: 是的，完全同意。

sentences.en: And I think it's there is this kind of moral injury when we think about the NHS and private practice.
sentences.zh: 我认为当我们想到 NHS 和私人执业时，存在一种道德伤害。

sentences.en: And I mean, this can be a whole conversation in itself, isn't it?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这本身就可以是一个完整的对话，不是吗？

sentences.en: But, yeah, and I think the anxiety also is, from a trainee perspective, through some of the conversations I've had, is going into it too early.
sentences.zh: 但是，是的，我认为焦虑也来自于，从实习生的角度来看，通过我进行的一些对话，是太早进入这个领域。

sentences.en: I know you mentioned you spent eight years in the NHS before considering private work.
sentences.zh: 我知道你提到你在 NHS 工作了八年才考虑私人工作。

sentences.en: And I've heard that people are one year in post-qualified and have already started their own practice or renting rooms in London for their own private practice.
sentences.zh: 我听说有人在获得资格后一年就已经开始了他们自己的执业，或者在伦敦租用房间进行私人执业。

sentences.en: So, yeah, I think that causes me a bit of anxiety because I'm like, wait a minute, I've done, you know, this is my fourth placement.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，我认为这让我有点焦虑，因为我在想，等一下，我已经完成了，你知道，这是我的第四个实习。

sentences.en: And so I've had a taste of this job role in four different places.
sentences.zh: 所以我已经在四个不同的地方体验过这个职位了。

sentences.en: But is that enough?
sentences.zh: 但这足够吗？

sentences.en: And, you know, it's not a qualified case role that I've been doing.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，我所做的并不是一个合格的案例角色。

sentences.en: I've been doing a trainee case, trainee cases and caseload.
sentences.zh: 我一直在做实习生的案例和工作量。

sentences.en: Am I confident enough?
sentences.zh: 我足够自信吗？

sentences.en: Do I feel like I need more support?
sentences.zh: 我觉得我需要更多的支持吗？

sentences.en: Like I'm going to miss that from the NHS, that supervision, the kind of clinicians coming together, the MDT.
sentences.zh: 就像我会怀念 NHS 的那种督导，那种临床医生聚在一起，那种多学科团队（MDT）。

sentences.en: Like there's a lot of valuable things there that may be so early on to leave and to move and become more independent, again, is maybe a bit daunting.
sentences.zh: 那里有很多有价值的东西，如果这么早就离开并转而变得更加独立，再次，可能有点令人望而生畏。

sentences.en: But I do appreciate that some people might be in that position as well if it feels like there aren't as many jobs going around.
sentences.zh: 但我确实理解，如果感觉工作机会不多，有些人可能也会处于那种境地。

sentences.en: Yeah, absolutely.
sentences.zh: 是的，绝对是。

sentences.en: This isn't an ideal scenario.
sentences.zh: 这不是一个理想的情况。

sentences.en: And I definitely learned so much from my first qualified post about being qualified and about being a clinical psychologist within that team and finding my feet,
sentences.zh: 我确实从我的第一份合格职位中学到了很多关于成为一名合格临床心理学家的知识，在那个团队中找到了自己的位置，

sentences.en: finding them quite quickly, I have to say, because they definitely wanted me to be up and running.
sentences.zh: 我必须说，找到位置的速度很快，因为他们确实希望我能尽快上手。

sentences.en: There wasn't this kid gloves that actually at the time I thought I needed, but actually I don't think I did.
sentences.zh: 并没有那种我当时以为我需要的“温室保护”，但实际上我认为我并不需要。

sentences.en: They, you know, they were like amazing.
sentences.zh: 他们，你知道，他们太棒了。

sentences.en: We've wanted someone in this role for so long.
sentences.zh: 我们在这个职位上寻找某人已经很久了。

sentences.en: We're delighted to have you.
sentences.zh: 我们很高兴你能来。

sentences.en: Off you go.
sentences.zh: 去吧。

sentences.en: And that was probably quite empowering, actually, because it kind of like, oh, OK, they see me as competent and ready and able to do this rather than, you know, it's not like.
sentences.zh: 事实上，这可能相当令人振奋，因为这就像是，哦，好吧，他们认为我有能力、准备好了，并且能够胜任这项工作，而不是，你知道，并不是那种感觉。

sentences.en: So my experience when I came back from bereavement leave after my dad died is that, yes, I was given a slower pace.
sentences.zh: 所以，我父亲去世后，当我结束丧假回来时，我的经历是，是的，我的工作节奏确实放慢了。

sentences.en: I was, you know, more thought given about my capacity and what I what I could give and what would be maybe a bit too much.
sentences.zh: 你知道，他们更多地考虑了我的承受能力，以及我能付出什么，什么可能有点过头了。

sentences.en: It's not like that when you're qualified, that it wasn't like that.
sentences.zh: 当你获得资格后，情况并非如此，当时并不是那样的。

sentences.en: And that's what I thought I wanted.
sentences.zh: 而那正是我以为我想要的。

sentences.en: In hindsight, I didn't get that.
sentences.zh: 事后看来，我并没有得到那个。

sentences.en: And I'm glad I didn't, because that would have fed into the narrative that I couldn't do it.
sentences.zh: 我很高兴我没有得到，因为那会助长我无法胜任工作的说法。

sentences.en: But that said, whilst I might never have applied for that job that I did get and was in for almost four years, if there'd been more jobs available closer to home.
sentences.zh: 但话虽如此，虽然如果离家更近的地方有更多工作机会，我可能永远不会申请我后来得到并做了近四年的那份工作。

sentences.en: I'm so glad I did that work.
sentences.zh: 但我很高兴我做了那份工作。

sentences.en: I loved it.
sentences.zh: 我热爱它。

sentences.en: I loved, loved, loved it.
sentences.zh: 我非常、非常、非常热爱它。

sentences.en: I learned so much.
sentences.zh: 我学到了很多。

sentences.en: And it was, yeah, I think back very fondly to those times working in those two services because it was split poSt.
sentences.zh: 而且，是的，回想起在那些服务机构工作的时光，我感到非常怀念，因为那是分职位的。

sentences.en: But, yeah,
sentences.zh: 但是，是的，

sentences.en: I definitely am pleased that I didn't go straight into private practice because there's something about holding a clinical caseload as a qualified member of staff that did take a bit of adjusting,
sentences.zh: 我确实很高兴我没有直接进入私人执业，因为作为一名合格的员工承担临床病例确实需要一点适应过程，

sentences.en: I would say.
sentences.zh: 我想是这样。

sentences.en: Suddenly, when you're signing your name and you have clinical responsibility, I definitely felt like I needed some support leaning into that aspect.
sentences.zh: 突然间，当你签下自己的名字并承担临床责任时，我确实觉得我需要一些支持来应对这一方面。

sentences.en: And had I just been trying to set up my business, do all of those things, think about referral,
sentences.zh: 如果我当时只是试图建立自己的事业，做所有那些事情，考虑转诊，

sentences.en: think about marketing and holding clinical responsibility and working out what was okay for private practice and what wasn't and what needed bumping up.
sentences.zh: 考虑市场营销，承担临床责任，弄清楚什么适合私人执业，什么不适合，以及什么需要加强。

sentences.en: Like, for me, personally, that would have been a stretch too far.
sentences.zh: 对我个人而言，那可能太吃力了。

sentences.en: So I'm very pleased that I had that period of employed life to be able to allow me to make that transition.
sentences.zh: 所以我很高兴我有一段受雇的生活，让我能够完成那个过渡。

sentences.en: Have you got any thoughts on that, Tanya?
sentences.zh: 对此你有什么想法吗，Tanya？

sentences.en: Yeah, it just reminded me of this lecturer that came into our university a couple of weeks ago.
sentences.zh: 是的，这让我想起了几周前来到我们大学的一位讲师。

sentences.en: And I think she worked inpatient and I think she said that when she qualified, she was the only psychologist in the trust and it's a trust towards the south of the country.
sentences.zh: 我想她是在住院部工作，她说她获得资格时，她是该信托机构中唯一的心理学家，那是一个位于国家南部的信托机构。

sentences.en: And we were all shocked.
sentences.zh: 我们都惊呆了。

sentences.en: We were all like, how?
sentences.zh: 我们都在想，怎么会？

sentences.en: Her supervisor was not in the truSt.
sentences.zh: 她的主管不在那个信托机构。

sentences.en: They had to externally hire a supervisor and kind of pay for that through the NHS.
sentences.zh: 他们不得不从外部聘请主管，并以某种方式通过NHS支付费用。

sentences.en: And she was, she'd been in that role since she qualified and she's still in that role.
sentences.zh: 她从获得资格起就一直担任那个角色，现在仍然在那个岗位上。

sentences.en: And it really is amazing because I think she's doing such amazing work and clearly so needed in an inpatient setting.
sentences.zh: 这真的很了不起，因为我认为她正在做如此出色的工作，而且在住院环境中显然非常需要她。

sentences.en: And I remember she said when she qualified, she thought, you know, I've got a job, so that's great.
sentences.zh: 我记得她说，当她获得资格时，她想，你知道，我有工作了，这太棒了。

sentences.en: I'm going into inpatient.
sentences.zh: 我要去住院部工作了。

sentences.en: I don't have that experience or like she didn't have, feel like her placements were that relevant to her qualified role.
sentences.zh: 我没有那种经验，或者说她觉得她的实习经历与她获得资格后的角色关联不大。

sentences.en: But she kind of said that's OK.
sentences.zh: 但她觉得没关系。

sentences.en: So she took up private work almost as a way to top up her experiences, which is the first time I heard that, which is really interesting.
sentences.zh: 所以她从事私人工作，几乎是为了补充她的经验，这是我第一次听说，非常有趣。

sentences.en: Because she said, well, I've never really done OCD during my placements, so let me just privately work to find an OCD client to kind of explore that,
sentences.zh: 因为她说，好吧，我在实习期间从未真正处理过强迫症（OCD），所以让我私下工作来寻找一个强迫症客户，以便探索一下，

sentences.en: gain that to a certain sort of like competent level, understand the kind of how to deliver the intervention.
sentences.zh: 达到某种胜任水平，了解如何提供干预措施。

sentences.en: And so, you know, when it comes to my inpatient work, I know how to, you know, how to do that.
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道，当涉及到我的住院工作时，我知道如何去做。

sentences.en: It doesn't feel like it's first time around.
sentences.zh: 感觉不再是第一次了。

sentences.en: Yeah, which I found really interesting.
sentences.zh: 是的，我觉得这非常有趣。

sentences.en: So I didn't think that, you know, the private work could also supplement, you know,
sentences.zh: 所以我没想到，你知道，私人工作也可以补充，你知道，

sentences.en: some of the things that you wouldn't necessarily get in certain qualified NHS posts to kind of boost up your experience.
sentences.zh: 你在某些NHS合格职位中不一定能获得的东西，从而提升你的经验。

sentences.en: Yeah, that is interesting.
sentences.zh: 是的，那确实很有趣。

sentences.en: And I think I tend to only work with people using the skill set that I had in the NHS or, you know, I might have done some additional training.
sentences.zh: 而且我认为我倾向于只使用我在NHS中拥有的技能集与人们一起工作，或者，你知道，我可能做了一些额外的培训。

sentences.en: But it's certainly in those areas that the passion was ignited for me in my in my kind of client work in the NHS.
sentences.zh: 但可以肯定的是，在那些领域，我在NHS客户工作中的热情被点燃了。

sentences.en: But yeah, like imagine being the only psychologist like, oh, I think I'd find that quite lonely.
sentences.zh: 但是，是的，想象一下成为唯一的心理学家，哦，我想我会觉得那很孤独。

sentences.en: Like I really enjoyed our kind of wider psychology kind of away days and events where we could all be inspired by one another's practice and eat biscuits.
sentences.zh: 我真的很喜欢我们那种更广泛的心理学外出日和活动，在那里我们可以从彼此的实践中获得灵感，并吃饼干。

sentences.en: And like, yeah, I definitely like the energy of being around other people.
sentences.zh: 而且，是的，我确实喜欢和别人在一起的活力。

sentences.en: And I guess this is why I've curated this aspiring psych community, really, in the membership.
sentences.zh: 我想这就是为什么我真的在会员社区中策划了这个有抱负的心理学家社区。

sentences.en: I like learning from others and being inspired by others.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢向他人学习并从他人那里获得灵感。

sentences.en: I think I would find it quite difficult to be the only.
sentences.zh: 我想如果我是唯一的一个，我会觉得很难。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Not something I considered.
sentences.zh: 这不是我考虑过的事情。

sentences.en: Yeah, definitely.
sentences.zh: 是的，绝对是。

sentences.en: And I think there is, you know, we kind of spoke about having like that bond as trainees.
sentences.zh: 而且我认为，你知道，我们谈到了作为实习生拥有那种纽带。

sentences.en: But also, I think under the NHS, you do have that kind of shared identity.
sentences.zh: 但我也认为，在NHS下，你确实拥有那种共同的身份。

sentences.en: And if it is going on away days or just, you know, even now we're thinking about planning on Christmas do like these are like things that you'd get in the NHS,
sentences.zh: 如果是去参加外出日，或者只是，你知道，即使现在我们正在考虑计划圣诞聚会，这些都是你在NHS中会得到的东西，

sentences.en: which obviously you do pay for it doesn't get funded.
sentences.zh: 当然你是自己付钱的，没有资金支持。

sentences.en: They don't have the money for that.
sentences.zh: 他们没有钱做那个。

sentences.en: But there is something in that, I guess, in that struggle of working things out in the NHS that really ties you together, which is really nice.
sentences.zh: 但我猜，在NHS中解决问题的挣扎中确实有一些东西能真正把你们联系在一起，这真的很棒。

sentences.en: But maybe, yeah, you wouldn't have to have or you have to kind of curate a little bit more in private work.
sentences.zh: 但也许，是的，你不需要拥有，或者你必须在私人工作中多策划一点。

sentences.en: Yeah, we definitely do have to fund it all ourselves.
sentences.zh: 是的，我们确实必须全部自己出资。

sentences.en: And it's reminded me of a post I saw on social media the other day.
sentences.zh: 这让我想起了前几天我在社交媒体上看到的一篇帖子。

sentences.en: I don't know if you saw it.
sentences.zh: 我不知道你是否看到了。

sentences.en: Someone was celebrating their long service award.
sentences.zh: 有人在庆祝他们的长期服务奖。

sentences.en: It was either 30 years or 50 years in the NHS.
sentences.zh: 要么是在NHS工作了30年，要么是50年。

sentences.en: And they'd been given a little plastic window, a little plastic cellophane bag with a single circular tea bag in it.
sentences.zh: 他们给了一个小塑料窗，一个装有一个圆形茶包的小塑料玻璃纸袋。

sentences.en: And it said, thank you for your, you know, 50 years of service or 30 years of service, whatever it was.
sentences.zh: 上面写着，感谢你的，你知道，50年服务或30年服务，无论是什么。

sentences.en: Here's a little treat.
sentences.zh: 这是一个小礼物。

sentences.en: And it's like, never more have I remembered what it's like to work for the NHS than that gift, you know.
sentences.zh: 就像是，我从未比那份礼物更清楚地记得在NHS工作是什么感觉，你知道。

sentences.en: And to someone who's worked in corporate industry where you get, you know, your choice of sparkling drinks or, you know, a lovely coffee machine and, you know, this,
sentences.zh: 对于一个在企业界工作过的人来说，你可以得到，你知道，你选择的气泡饮料，或者，你知道，一台可爱的咖啡机，还有，你知道，这个，

sentences.en: that and the other.
sentences.zh: 那个，以及其他东西。

sentences.en: And would you like some whipped cream on that?
sentences.zh: 你想要在上面加点鲜奶油吗？

sentences.en: Like, yeah, never more has there been a stark comparison of, oh, yeah, I get it.
sentences.zh: 就像，是的，从来没有比这更鲜明的对比了，哦，是的，我明白了。

sentences.en: I remember.
sentences.zh: 我记得。

sentences.en: Yeah, I totally.
sentences.zh: 是的，我完全同意。

sentences.en: That's hilarious.
sentences.zh: 那太搞笑了。

sentences.en: And, yeah, it just made me think about how, you know, at this stage, we are also thinking about where, where we want to be, if that's in the NHS or, you know,
sentences.zh: 而且，是的，这只是让我想到，你知道，在这个阶段，我们也在考虑我们想要在哪里，如果是在NHS，或者，你知道，

sentences.en: if we're thinking about private work at some point and just pulling upon our interests.
sentences.zh: 如果我们正在考虑在某个时候进行私人工作，并利用我们的兴趣。

sentences.en: So maybe if I could, yeah, I think the next thing I wanted to maybe just mention is how, again, that kind of like reframe on this situation about trainees,
sentences.zh: 所以也许如果我可以，是的，我想我接下来可能想提的是，关于实习生的情况，那种重新审视，

sentences.en: like figuring out what they, what they like and what they don't like in terms of like clinical work and how that can inform what they do.
sentences.zh: 就像弄清楚他们在临床工作方面喜欢什么和不喜欢什么，以及这如何能为他们所做的事情提供信息。

sentences.en: Yeah, I think that's sort of.
sentences.zh: 是的，我想那是某种。

sentences.en: Yeah, absolutely.
sentences.zh: 是的，绝对。

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 绝对。

sentences.en: Are there any kind of last reflections or things we could consider before we finish today, Tanya?
sentences.zh: 在今天结束之前，还有什么最后的反思或我们可以考虑的事情吗，Tanya？

sentences.en: Yeah, I guess I've been thinking a little bit about, again, a positive reframe about this kind of situation with post qualifying options for us trainees.
sentences.zh: 是的，我想我一直在思考，再次，关于我们实习生在获得资格后的选择这种情况的一个积极的重新审视。

sentences.en: And I guess placement is a good time where we can figure out, you know, what it is we like and don't like.
sentences.zh: 而且我认为实习是一个很好的时间，我们可以弄清楚，你知道，我们喜欢什么和不喜欢什么。

sentences.en: And for some of us, me included, I think having such varied placement experiences, I'm not quite sure where I'd want to go to be qualified.
sentences.zh: 对于我们中的一些人，包括我，我认为拥有如此多样的实习经历，我不确定在获得资格后我想去哪里。

sentences.en: But I think I've realised that that's OK and I can use qualified life as an opportunity to kind of explore that a little bit more.
sentences.zh: 但我认为我已经意识到这没关系，我可以利用获得资格后的生活作为一个机会来进一步探索这一点。

sentences.en: But it's also, yeah, leaning into intereSt.
sentences.zh: 但这同时也是，是的，倾向于兴趣。

sentences.en: And so over training,
sentences.zh: 所以在培训期间，

sentences.en: I've been becoming more and more interested in yoga and I've been maybe thinking about if I could integrate that into therapy and do like a yoga therapy course or do yoga teacher training and see how that can inform clinical practice or kind of vice versa.
sentences.zh: 我对瑜伽越来越感兴趣，我可能一直在想，如果我能把它整合到治疗中，做一个瑜伽治疗课程，或者做瑜伽教师培训，看看这如何能为临床实践提供信息，或者反之亦然。

sentences.en: I have a really good friend who's an artist and so she's thinking a little bit about integrating art into her work or doing any extra training.
sentences.zh: 我有一个很好的朋友是艺术家，所以她正在考虑将艺术整合到她的工作中，或者进行任何额外的培训。

sentences.en: So I think, you know, although we have this training that kind of gears us up to a certain level, we are, you know, we are still humans, we are still individual,
sentences.zh: 所以我认为，你知道，虽然我们有这种让我们达到一定水平的培训，但我们，你知道，我们仍然是人类，我们仍然是个体，

sentences.en: we have our interests.
sentences.zh: 我们有我们的兴趣。

sentences.en: And so maybe now that, you know, we're thinking about post qualified options, we're thinking, how can we become individuals again?
sentences.zh: 所以也许现在，你知道，我们正在考虑获得资格后的选择，我们正在思考，我们如何能再次成为个体？

sentences.en: You know, how can we find that route that we want to take individually, as well as, you know, having the back of being a clinical psychologist,
sentences.zh: 你知道，我们如何能找到我们想要单独采取的那条路线，以及，你知道，拥有作为临床心理学家的背景，

sentences.en: but integrating some of those things.
sentences.zh: 但整合其中一些东西。

sentences.en: And I've also found that LinkedIn has been really helpful to kind of speak about some of those things and kind of enter into a world of networking and trying to find kind of like minded people,
sentences.zh: 而且我还发现LinkedIn在谈论其中一些事情，并进入一个网络世界，试图找到志同道合的人，

sentences.en: people who align with those interests.
sentences.zh: 与那些兴趣一致的人，真的很有帮助。

sentences.en: And I think that's really helpful, maybe thinking about post qualified kind of options and building that network and finding certain opportunities.
sentences.zh: 而且我认为这真的很有帮助，也许考虑获得资格后的选择，建立那个网络并找到某些机会。

sentences.en: So I think LinkedIn has been helpful and that's also how we got introduced.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为LinkedIn很有帮助，这也是我们被介绍认识的方式。

sentences.en: So I think, yeah, helpful in many ways.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为，是的，在很多方面都有帮助。

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 绝对。

sentences.en: I love LinkedIn.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢LinkedIn。

sentences.en: And at the time of recording, I think I'm about 19 and a half thousand connections on there.
sentences.zh: 在录制时，我想我在那里大约有19500个联系人。

sentences.en: So I really do love the variety of conversations.
sentences.zh: 所以我真的很喜欢各种各样的对话。

sentences.en: And we've also just yesterday, I recorded an episode entirely on using LinkedIn as a kind of psychology and mental health professional.
sentences.zh: 而且我们就在昨天，我录制了一集完全关于使用LinkedIn作为心理学和心理健康专业人士的内容。

sentences.en: So, yeah, if people are like LinkedIn, really do listen up for that one.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，如果人们喜欢LinkedIn，一定要听那一集。

sentences.en: Tanya, I've loved our conversation.
sentences.zh: Tanya，我喜欢我们的谈话。

sentences.en: It's been so useful to think about what this evolving landscape of kind of qualified life looks like right now.
sentences.zh: 思考目前这种不断发展的合格生活景观是什么样子，真的非常有用。

sentences.en: Thank you for your thoughtful time and consideration and wishing you all the best with your thesis,
sentences.zh: 感谢你深思熟虑的时间和考虑，祝你在论文方面一切顺利，

sentences.en: with the rest of your final year and with securing a job that feels like a bit of you.
sentences.zh: 祝你最后一年剩下的时间顺利，并祝你找到一份让你感觉适合你的工作。

sentences.en: Thank you, Marianne.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，Marianne。

sentences.en: Yeah, it's been a pleasure speaking today and having new reflections about qualified life.
sentences.zh: 是的，今天很高兴能交谈，并对合格生活有了新的反思。

sentences.en: So thank you.
sentences.zh: 所以谢谢你。

sentences.en: Appreciate it.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢。

sentences.en: Thank you so much.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢你。

sentences.en: Stay in touch.
sentences.zh: 保持联系。

sentences.en: Take care.
sentences.zh: 保重。

sentences.en: Thank you so much again for Tanya's time in speaking with us.
sentences.zh: 再次非常感谢Tanya花时间与我们交谈。

sentences.en: Has it resonated with you?
sentences.zh: 它引起你的共鸣了吗？

sentences.en: What stage of your career are you at?
sentences.zh: 你处于职业生涯的哪个阶段？

sentences.en: Let's go wild in the comments.
sentences.zh: 让我们在评论区畅所欲言吧。

sentences.en: And please do let me know whether you're watching on YouTube or whether you're listening as an MP3.
sentences.zh: 请让我知道你是在YouTube上观看，还是在听MP3。

sentences.en: I love this chance to connect with you and I hope that you like being here too.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢这个与你联系的机会，我希望你也喜欢在这里。

sentences.en: If you do, please like, please subscribe, please show me your support.
sentences.zh: 如果你喜欢，请点赞，请订阅，请向我展示你的支持。

sentences.en: That really is the kindest thing you can do for any podcaster or creator that you rate and it doesn't cost you a penny.
sentences.zh: 这真的是你能为你评价的任何播客或创作者做的最友善的事情，而且它不会花费你一分钱。

sentences.en: And the other day, someone even said that when they're watching on YouTube,
sentences.zh: 前几天，甚至有人说，当他们在YouTube上观看时，

sentences.en: they choose to watch the adverts because they know that's their way of giving back in a way that doesn't cost them,
sentences.zh: 他们选择观看广告，因为他们知道这是他们以一种不花钱的方式回馈的方式，

sentences.en: but does help me to cover my costs to create this content for you.
sentences.zh: 但这确实帮助我支付了为你们创作这些内容的成本。

sentences.en: So if you wanted to do the same, I'd be so very grateful.
sentences.zh: 所以如果你想做同样的事情，我会非常感激。

sentences.en: If you would like to go one step further and be one of my biggest fans, you can do that by joining my paid community,
sentences.zh: 如果你想更进一步，成为我最大的粉丝之一，你可以通过加入我的付费社区来做到这一点，

sentences.en: which is on YouTube with Dr. Marianne Trent on Apple where I'm the Aspiring Psychologist podcaSt.
sentences.zh: 它在YouTube上，Dr. Marianne Trent在Apple上，我是Aspiring Psychologist播客。

sentences.en: You might choose to do this because you're a qualified clinician or just because you want to be able to show me your support and tell me that you really do rate this content.
sentences.zh: 你可能会选择这样做，因为你是一名合格的临床医生，或者只是因为你想要能够向我展示你的支持，并告诉我你真的很看重这些内容。

sentences.en: The podcast itself will always remain free.
sentences.zh: 播客本身将永远保持免费。

sentences.en: I will never ring fence or gatekeep that.
sentences.zh: 我永远不会围栏或设置门槛。

sentences.en: But this really does help me to to cover my costs because this podcast takes me about two days a week to to record,
sentences.zh: 但这确实帮助我支付了我的成本，因为这个播客花了我大约每周两天的时间来录制，

sentences.en: to research, to edit, to do all of those good things and the emails alongside it.
sentences.zh: 研究，编辑，做所有那些好的事情，以及随之而来的电子邮件。

sentences.en: So, yeah, that is that is not a small amount of time.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，那不是一小段时间。

sentences.en: So any contribution you can make is so gratefully received.
sentences.zh: 所以你所能做的任何贡献都非常感激。

sentences.en: If you're looking to become a psychologist, then let this be your guide.
sentences.zh: 如果你正在寻求成为一名心理学家，那么让这成为你的指南。

sentences.en: With this podcast, that's your side.
sentences.zh: 有了这个播客，这就是你的方面。

sentences.en: You'll be on your waist, the Aspiring Psychologist podcast with Dr. Marianne Trent.
sentences.zh: 你将走在你的腰上，Aspiring Psychologist播客与Dr. Marianne Trent。

sentences.en: Psychologists, what if you could earn money beyond trading your time for money?
sentences.zh: 心理学家们，如果你能赚到钱，而不仅仅是用时间换钱，会怎样？

sentences.en: I'm Dr. Marianne Trent, clinical psychologist, and I've been developing passive and recurring income streams since 2019.
sentences.zh: 我是Dr. Marianne Trent，临床心理学家，自2019年以来，我一直在开发被动和经常性收入流。

sentences.en: I have some exciting news.
sentences.zh: 我有一些令人兴奋的消息。

sentences.en: Sophie Foote's one to many program is now open for enrollment.
sentences.zh: Sophie Foote的一对多项目现在开放报名。

sentences.en: It's designed to help you turn your expertise into scalable offers like courses, memberships and digital products.
sentences.zh: 它旨在帮助你将你的专业知识转化为可扩展的报价，如课程、会员资格和数字产品。

sentences.en: I completed the program myself in 2022 and have since supported two cohorts of psychologists through their journeys too.
sentences.zh: 我在2022年自己完成了该项目，此后也支持了两批心理学家完成他们的旅程。

sentences.en: And if you join through my affiliate link, you'll receive Sophie's bonuses plus my own exclusive support package at no extra coSt.
sentences.zh: 如果你通过我的专属链接加入，你将获得索菲的奖励，以及我提供的额外支持礼包，无需支付任何额外费用。

sentences.en: That includes six months of WhatsApp support, four group masterminds, masterclasses, personalized guidance, a Fortnum and Mason treat, and a time-limited one-to-one coaching bonus.
sentences.zh: 这包括六个月的WhatsApp支持、四场小组智囊团会议、大师课、个性化指导、一份Fortnum and Mason礼品，以及限时的一对一辅导奖励。

sentences.en: Enrollment closes on Monday the 16th of November at 10pm.
sentences.zh: 报名将于11月16日周一晚上10点截止。

sentences.en: Find out more via my bonus page linked in the description.
sentences.zh: 详情请查看描述中链接的奖励页面。

sentences.en: And remember, you must purchase through my link to receive my bonuses.
sentences.zh: 请记住，你必须通过我的链接购买才能获得我的奖励。

sentences.en: I'm here if you have any questions.
sentences.zh: 如果你有任何问题，随时可以找我。
